fields.description: Issue features editorials and local reporting on the Miami newspaper strike and public trust in coverage (contrasting President Truman and the Miami Herald); criticism of Florida East Coast Railway for failing to send condolences to the family of employee-hero William “Buck” Weaver; advocacy for municipal ownership and opposition to renewal of Florida Power & Light’s electricity franchise (franchise expiring 1955) framed as a major financial stake for Miami; city commission and state railroad commission jurisdiction issues; warnings about poisonous diesel exhaust from new Miami Transit Company buses; notes on cooperative housing, tax exemptions, flood control needs, and a reported incident of antisemitic harassment of a local shopkeeper.
